reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: I don’t like that the only way to get help is by watching ads. Some of these are really obscure so you have to have clues.  At least half the rewards I’m supposed to get from watching ads are not even awarded to me. I watched the whole ad and then it kicked me out of the app and doesn’t give me the reward.  I would like to be able to save up some more help such as eliminating, unused letters, or I would like to choose which letter I want to reveal.

reviews.title: Game
reviews.text:
This is a fun game but they take forever to add new levels. It’s probably been 3 or 4 months or so since the last time anything new was added. 

Update: this original review was back in February 2022. We are now in July 2022 and new levels have still not been added making it almost a year now. It’s getting to the point where, even though it’s a fun game, I might just delete it. At this point it’s just taking up unnecessary space.

Final update: September 21, 2023 still no new levels. I’m convinced they have given up trying to find new content. This will be it from until they add new levels but for now it stops at level 260.
